name: sgs/business-info
title: Business Info
description: Display business details from Settings > Business Details.

iconColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the icon's stroke instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconColour at render time.

iconColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state sibling of iconColourGradient. Non-empty wins over iconColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

textColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the value text instead of a flat colour (background-clip:text). Non-empty wins over textColour at render time.

textColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state sibling of textColourGradient. Non-empty wins over textColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

labelColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the label text (currently only visible on .sgs-business-hours__day) instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over labelColour at render time.

labelColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of labelColourHover. Non-empty wins over labelColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

hover-colour-older-browsers.reason: Feeds a hardcoded single-colour-stop sweep animation baked into style.css — the general gradient trio cannot drop in without redesigning that effect. The mechanism: attributionHoverColour holds the gradient colour-stop inside background-image:linear-gradient(...) text-clip sweep (modern browsers); attributionHoverColourFallback holds the plain color: declaration inside the @supports not (background-clip:text) fallback (older browsers). A color: declaration can never legally hold a CSS gradient, so the pair stays split. Structurally impossible, not merely undecided.

wrapper.label: Info box
wrapper._note_typography: Typography routes through the shared TypographyControls/sgs_typography_css_rule() mechanism — root prefix '' (fontSize/fontSizeUnit/fontFamily/fontWeight/fontStyle/lineHeight/lineHeightUnit). render.php applies the rule to $root_sel, the whole `.{uid}` wrapper div (there is no `selectors.typography` override). The fontFamily control is exposed via showFontFamily.

text.label: Value text
text._note_gradient: textColourGradient is the text-colour gradient sibling to textColour, same background-clip:text mechanism as sgs/counter's numberColourGradient.
text._note_ownership: css:color -> textColour is mapped explicitly — without it, placement-reach's cluster fallback would misroute textColour to the 'icon' element (icon also declares the 'text' cluster for its own iconColour). textColour is this element's own base colour, sibling to the explicit textColourGradient.
text._note_hover: textColourHover/textColourHoverGradient give the top SgsColourPanel's 'Text colour' row the framework's 2-state standard (sgs_text_states_css()). render.php emits both states via that shared helper, scoped to the same wrapper selector as the base colour.

label.label: Label
label._note_gradient: labelColourGradient is the text-colour gradient sibling to labelColour, same background-clip:text mechanism. labelColour currently only paints .sgs-business-hours__day (the 'hours' displayType) — the gradient sibling follows the same real paint target.

icon.label: Icon
icon._note: iconColour resolves via css:color (style.css `color: var(--sgs-bi-icon-colour, currentColor)`) — mirrors sgs/icon's own icon element + sgs/accordion's toggle-icon element, which use the same css:color/attrMap convention for a functional icon colour (Spec 35 vocabulary fix). showIcon remains an unmapped bespoke toggle, not a style-cluster member. `css:stroke` (icon/SVG gradient mechanism) is explicit-mapped to `iconColourGradient` — non-empty wins over iconColour's flat currentColor paint at render time (helpers-svg-gradient.php).
icon._note_hover: iconColourHover/iconColourHoverGradient mirror sgs/button's icon element exactly (same Lucide stroke-based icon painted via ancestor `color:`, same helpers-svg-gradient.php stroke-gradient mechanism) — see block.json's button icon element for the identical states.hover shape.

link.label: Link
link._note: The `<a class="sgs-business-info__link">` rendered for phone/email/map/attribution display types — phone/email always render as links (there is no use case for an unclickable phone number or email address). `attributionHoverColour`/`attributionHoverColourFallback` only paint the attribution/website-credit hover sweep on `.sgs-business-attribution .sgs-business-info__link` (style.css), not a general phone/email link-hover. `attributionHoverColour` feeds the gradient colour-stop inside the `background-image:linear-gradient(...)` text-clip sweep (modern browsers); `attributionHoverColourFallback` feeds the plain `color:` declaration inside the `@supports not (background-clip:text)` fallback (older browsers). A `color:` declaration can never legally hold a CSS gradient, so the pair stays split. Both are exposed ONLY on a displayType==='attribution' control in edit.js. `prefix: ""` is the documented explicit opt-out from orphan-scanning (see resolveMember's `!== undefined` contract) — correct here because there is nothing else on this element for the scan to usefully claim; the css_element-drift audit this element exists to satisfy only checks that the KEY `link` resolves, not that every attribute funnels through the cluster/state machinery.
